<a id="entropy-history-and-record--熵的历史与记录"></a>
# Entropy, history and record

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`entropy-history-and-record` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](entropy-history-and-record.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Premise-free, the history of exchanges is monotone; lossless exchange can continue and return; under balance and the first law an arrow leaves a finite family no change at arbitrarily late steps; and recording each exchange within the conserved amount decomposes the least loss exactly.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The history of a family's exchanges since T never shrinks; this uses no balance premise. (`Becoming.Flow.exchangeCount`, `Becoming.Flow.history_mono`)
2. In a balanced flow every change of a member's level is an exchange with the family. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.exchanges_of_change`)
3. An exchange with its reverse (the same formations, each taking what it gave and giving what it took) restores every level, while the history counts both. (`Becoming.Flow.Reverses`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.restores_levels_not_history`)
4. Zero: the first law at a fixed unit is nothing from nothing, losing nothing is getting back exactly, and dissipation is the first law with a least loss. (`Becoming.Flow.Gainless`, `Becoming.Flow.Conserving`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.gainless`)
5. Under the first law a reverse is within the law exactly where the exchange is lossless, and under dissipation no exchange is reversed. (`Becoming.Flow.Reverses.gainlessOn_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.irreversible`)
6. Passing is finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed at every step, each exchange reversed at the next, arising and ceasing recurring, its history growing by one at every step. (`Becoming.Passing.passes`, `Becoming.Passing.history_grows`)
7. The record: with the record of the exchanges counted as a condition given to and never taken from, balance with the record counted is balance, as a whole and at each step on each family. (`Becoming.Flow.withRecord`, `Becoming.Web.withRecord`, `Becoming.Flow.balances_withRecord`, `Becoming.Flow.balancesOn_withRecord`)
8. A flow dissipates on a family across a step exactly where, for some record, every exchange conserves the family with its record exactly and leaves the record at least one unit, and exactly where, recording each exchange at one unit, the family with its record gains nothing. (`Becoming.Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_conserved`, `Becoming.Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_unitRecord`, `Becoming.Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_recorded`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.of_recorded`)
9. Both parts are needed; under the first law the record receives exactly what the family loses. (`Becoming.Passing.record_needs_both`, `Becoming.Flow.GainlessOn.residues_lost`)
10. The amount dissipated never falls; with the stock it is conserved under the first law, the history is within it, and under loss in proportion q everything taken is at most q + 1 times it. (`Becoming.Flow.dissipated`, `Becoming.Flow.dissipated_mono`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.stock_dissipated`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.history_within`, `Becoming.Flow.DissipatesBy.uptake_le_lost`, `Becoming.Flow.uptake_within_dissipated`)
11. Configurations: under the first law the family's configuration stays among its stock's configurations, configurations n K listing each way K units fall into n members exactly once. (`Becoming.Web.config_within`, `Becoming.configurations`, `Becoming.configurations_exact`)
12. Never revisiting, it changes at most that many times, so its change does not recur, and change without end revisits, and under dissipation a family never revisits. (`Becoming.Web.Revisits`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.changes_within`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.changes_within_conserving`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.rests_of_never_revisits`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.unending_change_revisits`, `Becoming.World.arising_revisits`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.never_revisits`)
13. The arrow: a quantity of the configuration that never falls and rises at every change rules out revisiting, so under the first law an arrow leaves change not recurring and while change goes on there is none. (`Becoming.Web.Arrow`, `Becoming.Web.never_revisits_of_arrow`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.rests_of_arrow`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.no_arrow`, `Becoming.World.no_arrow`, `Becoming.Passing.no_arrow`)
14. Merging: where change is a function of the configuration, rest after a change merges two configurations, with no law of the flow. (`Becoming.Web.Determined`, `Becoming.Web.merges_of_settles`, `Becoming.Web.Merges`)
15. Merging none, change never stops and under the first law revisits; never revisiting, under an arrow or under dissipation, it is not the case that it merges none. (`Becoming.Web.changes_persist`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.revisits_of_apart`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.merges_of_never_revisits`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.merges_of_arrow`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.merges_of_dissipates`)
16. Holding the history: where the configuration carries the history, its reading is an arrow, exchange stops within the configurations under the first law, and a finite world that keeps exchanging forgets. (`Becoming.Flow.CarriesHistory`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.arrow_of_carries`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.exchange_stops_of_carries`, `Becoming.World.forgets`)
17. Gathering: under exact conservation, every step enclosed, a record's level rises without end, gaining from beyond, in a world that is not finite. (`Becoming.Gathering.gathers`)
18. Instances of the laws of change: revisiting after a change is revisiting, an arrow marks every change, a merge along the family is a merge of the law, and determined change runs along the law's orbit. (`Becoming.Web.Revisits.recurs`, `Becoming.Web.Arrow.marks`, `Becoming.Web.Merges.law`, `Becoming.Web.Determined.orbit`)
19. The first law keeps the configurations among those within the stock at T (this bound is the supplied Z), so from every step on the configuration takes one value twice, constructively, and an arrow stops change. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.held`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.recurs`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.arrow_stops`)
20. Within that bound a law merging nothing brings the start back (the bound does the work, not losing alone: the successor law merges nothing and never returns); the present forgets the kept history; and an arrow or dissipation rules out a law merging nothing. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.returns_of_conserving`, `Becoming.Law.succ_open`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.present_forgets`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.not_conserving_of_arrow`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.not_conserving_of_dissipates`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Flow.history_mono itself uses no balance premise; connecting a level change to an exchange (Flow.Balances.exchanges_of_change), restoring levels under a reversal (Flow.Balances.restores_levels_not_history), and the other conditional results use balance and their stated local hypotheses.
- The first law (Flow.GainlessOn, Flow.Gainless: every closed family without repetition gets back at most what is taken from it) and losing nothing (Flow.ConservingOn, Flow.Conserving) are hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms; natural-number amounts at a fixed unit.
- Determined change (Web.Determined: from T on the next configuration is a function of the current one) is a hypothesis of the merging theorems; the spine's flow is indexed by steps and does not require it.
- Counting the record as a condition is a reading, following Ren on 11 October 2026: ‘I know what "Every exchange loses at least one smallest amount" is now, it is entropy’ and ‘pure thermodynamics, at atomic level, each exchange between objects holds the conservation of energy, but entropy still rise. zero premises.’
- The author's reading (AI, adopted on Ren's delegation): the record is what rises while every exchange conserves exactly. The theorems hold under either reading: Flow.balances_withRecord is an identity, and the laws without the record are stated too.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The theorems do not decide whether ‘entropy’ names the record in the conserved amount or the history; a reading: it names the record, the history being what the record records.
- Decomposing the least loss into the first law and a record in the conserved amount does not derive it.
- The merging conclusions are double negations, and only the dichotomy of merging or not is stated.
- The count of reachable configurations within the first law's list is not stated; their shrinking step by step holds for any determined law with no premise. Witness: `Becoming.Law.lost_stays`.
- A coarse-grained entropy rising from an ordered start needs a premise about the start and is not stated.
- The flow with the record counted has Option conditions and is not a world of one kind of relatum.
- The correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not physical derivations.
- **Counterexample:** Passing: finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed, each exchange reversed at the next step, not dissipative, arising and ceasing recurring, its configuration coming back every two steps, with no arrow, its change merging no configurations, its history growing at every step (Passing.passes, Passing.history_without_arrow): the first law gives neither rest nor dissipation. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Entropy.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Settling: one unit passes once, losslessly; the world never revisits and rests, is not dissipative, its rest merges configurations, and the level of the side receiving the unit is an arrow (Entropy.Settling.settles, Entropy.Settling.merges): never revisiting does not give dissipation. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Entropy.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Passing.record_needs_both: recording nothing, the family with its record gains nothing but the record misses every exchange; recording one unit each, the record holds every exchange but the family with it gains. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Entropy.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Gathering: exact conservation, every step enclosed, the exchange recurring, the record's level an arrow without end; the record gains from beyond, and the world is not finite (Gathering.gathers): the premises that the family gains nothing (no_arrow) and that the world is finite (World.no_arrow) do work. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Entropy.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps.

## Next

The count of reachable configurations within the first law's list, and every possibility kept where nothing merges; the record as a relatum in the census, so the counted flow is itself a world; a coarse-grained entropy with a premise about the start (periphery); continuous time and real amounts; an independent review.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Answers to Ren's three questions (the AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation). Is 0 possible: yes, exactly where lossless; in Ren's karmic reading, after a reverse the levels show no difference and the history does. Can entropy be derived: what rises with no premise is the history; the levels of a finite enclosure have no arrow while change goes on, an arrow or rest merges configurations, and holding the history in the configuration stops exchange; the least loss is exactly the first law with the record held in the conserved amount, a decomposition, not a derivation. The second-law form: the history and the amount dissipated never fall, the latter conserved with the stock and bounding uptake under loss in proportion, in keeping with the amount law (Flow.uptake_bound of rest-at-every-resolution). The correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not physical derivations: Clausius (a never-decreasing quantity); Boltzmann's W (configurations, the Einstein solid's multiplicity); Zermelo's and Poincaré's recurrence (unending_change_revisits); Loschmidt's reversibility (no_arrow); Landauer's erasure (merges_of_settles); Bennett's reversible computation keeping its history (World.forgets); Gouy–Stodola's available work (dissipatesOn_iff_conserved, residues_lost); open systems (Gathering). On the spine, ‘the levels restored, the history not’ is the distinction already drawn by endpoint-loss-and-return and by the counter added in ReturnConditions.lean, which come first; this result is its form on the flow and web, connected to the first law, dissipation and the count of configurations.

### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [continued-change-needs-openness](continued-change-needs-openness.md). The proof of never revisiting uses Flow.rise_lowers_on and Flow.fall_lowers_on (a member rising or falling in a family dissipated on lowers the stock); the finite-world results use World.rises_of_arises, World.falls_of_ceases and Flow.ExchangeRecurs.
  - Output: Under balance and dissipation, any change of a member's level in a family dissipated on strictly lowers the family's stock; under embodiment, arising is a rise and ceasing a fall.
  - Input: Where the configuration changes some member rises or falls (Web.changes_member), so under dissipation the stock strictly falls at every change and never rises, and cannot come back.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance; the family dissipated on from T on; a family without repetition. [Entropy.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Entropy.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [rest-at-every-resolution](rest-at-every-resolution.md). Flow.DissipatesBy.uptake_le_lost and Flow.uptake_within_dissipated use Flow.DissipatesBy and Flow.DissipatesBy.replenishment_le.
  - Output: Under loss in proportion q, q + 1 times what the family gets back is within q times what is taken from it, so what it gets back is within what is taken.
  - Input: So what is taken is what is got back with what is lost, and what is taken is at most q + 1 times what is lost.
  - Preserved conditions: Loss in proportion q on the family (at a fixed unit). [Entropy.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Entropy.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). The instance theorems use Becoming.Recurrence's Revisits, revisits_of_held, revisits_from, Marks, Marks.change_not_recurring, Law.orbit, Law.orbit_add, Law.Lossless, Law.Lossless.cancel, Law.Merges, Branching.Merges.not_lossless, Law.Returns, Law.withHistory and Law.present_forgets.
  - Output: With no premise: a sequence held by a list revisits (pigeonhole, without decidability); a marked change stops within finitely many configurations; a law merging nothing merges nothing over many steps; in an unfolding that keeps its history a finite present forgets.
  - Input: The family's configurations from T on are a sequence; where change is a function of the configuration, next is a law; under the first law the configurations are held by the list of those within the stock at T (Flow.Balances.held).
  - Preserved conditions: Balance; the family gaining nothing from T on (the first law); return and forgetting also need change determined by next from T on (Web.Determined). [Entropy.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Entropy.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [rest-with-refinement-counted](rest-with-refinement-counted.md). A parallel reading: R4 counts the splitting of the unit as a formation that gives without taking; this result counts the record of the exchanges as a condition only given to. Both reread without adding a premise; R4 obtains rest at every resolution, and this result decomposes the least loss into the first law and the record in the conserved amount. It answers R4's next step (whether the least loss can be derived, whether lossless exchanges exist).
- related, not a proved adapter: [endpoint-loss-and-return](endpoint-loss-and-return.md). Prior results: along an actual history, return holds exactly where every endpoint possibility is kept; the counter added in ReturnConditions.lean makes a native return no longer a return. restores_levels_not_history here is the same distinction on the flow; no formal adapter between them is claimed.
- related, not a proved adapter: [theory-of-becoming-foundation](theory-of-becoming-foundation.md). Unification plan R5: entropy, following Ren's questions of 11 October 2026, the strongest form without premise first; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.
